title: A smooth generic component in a nodal neighbourhood has a flat closure and finite etale boundary
statement:
Let $R\subset L$ be a valuation ring with fraction field $L$ [def-weil-field], so for every $a\in L^\times$ either $a$ or $a^{-1}$ belongs to $R$. Assume $L$ is separably closed [def-kun-separably-closed] and the primes of $R$ form a finite chain. Put $S=\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], with generic point $\xi$. Let $p:Z\to S$ be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], and finitely presented [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], of pure relative dimension one [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], with geometrically reduced fibres (every field extension of each residue field gives a reduced fibre [def-pc-reduced-scheme]). Let $A$ be an irreducible component [def-weil-irreducible-components] of $Z_\xi$, with reduced induced structure, and suppose $A$ is smooth and geometrically integral over $L$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. Let $H\subset Z$ be its reduced closed closure [lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme]. Suppose there is an open neighbourhood $N\subset Z$ containing all of $H$ such that $N\to S$ is nodal: every singular point of each geometric fibre has completed local ring $\Omega[[u,v]]/(uv)$ [def-weil-geometric-fibre, def-weil-pbc-adic-completion, def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. Let $Q\hookrightarrow N$ be a closed subscheme [def-weil-closed-immersion], etale over $S$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], contained in the relative smooth locus. Then $H$ is integral [def-pc-integral-scheme], and $H\to S$ is proper, flat, finitely presented, of pure relative dimension one, with nodal geometrically reduced fibres. Each $H_u$ is a union of entire irreducible components of $Z_u$, with their reduced structures. Let $J\subset N$ be the reduced closure of $N\setminus H$ and let $B=H\times_N J$ be the scheme-theoretic intersection. Both $B\to S$ and $Q\times_N H\to S$ are finite etale, their supports are disjoint, and they lie in the relative smooth locus of $H$. For every geometric point $\bar u\to S$, the support of $B_{\bar u}$ is exactly $H_{\bar u}\cap\overline{N_{\bar u}\setminus H_{\bar u}}$. In particular the integer
$$|H_{\bar u}\cap\overline{N_{\bar u}\setminus H_{\bar u}}|+|Q_{\bar u}\cap H_{\bar u}|$$
is independent of $\bar u$ and equals its value on a geometric generic fibre. No genus-zero hypothesis, numerical bound on this integer, or morphism contracting $A$ is assumed.
